# Jules Bockelee Morvan

> Jules Bockelee Morvan is a product and brand strategist in Paris and New York, working between the brand, the product and the people who build it, across hospitality, tech and consumer brands.

Jules has seen good ideas get lost in the handover more often than anywhere else: between the promise and the budget, the brand and the product, the pitch and the people who build it. That is where Jules works. Most recently a strategist, then product manager and strategy consultant at 44LLC, a New York strategy and design studio working with hotel groups; co-founder and creative director of Vybe Together, a social events app. BBA in Strategic Design & Management from Parsons School of Design. English and French, bilingual; Spanish, professional.

## Essays

- [Salt Water for a Thirsty Man](https://www.julesbockelee.com/thoughts/salt-water-for-a-thirsty-man) (2026-10-25): What we lost when our contacts became an audience, and why I am building Pollex.

## Selected projects

- Vybe Together (2020-2024): Making plans feel spontaneous again
- Cape (2024): Building a resort's identity from its market
- Eureka: Academic research is hard to break into.
- Mondadori Estate (2024): Selling a Puglian estate to hotel groups
- Caddis: My capstone, a brand strategy for Caddis.
- Enzo: Enzo is a banking app I built with a membership system behind it.
- Rebranding Frozen Foods: Four in five of the students I surveyed didn't like frozen meals, and none of them thought they were healthy.
- Clay: Clay wanted more of a presence online.
- Talaria: Seeing a doctor means time you don't have, a waiting room where you can pick something up, and a big bill.
- Cost Plus Drugs: A redesign of how Cost Plus Drugs works.
- NYCIC Annual Sponsorship Proposal: The NYC Innovation Collective brings together the people who run New York's accelerators and tech companies.
- Garrett: A media kit for Garrett, a New York creator with more than 365,000 followers who has worked with MrBeast and Cam Newton.
- Ben Sharf: A media kit for Ben Sharf, a podcaster and creator who works with bigger influencers and brands.
- New York Guys: A media kit for New York Guys, four creators (Garrett, Brendon, Bill and Phillip) who talk about life in the city, some of it comedy, some satire, some serious.
- The Surf Helmet: Surfers get hurt in wipeouts, on the reef and on the sea bed, and hardly any of them wear a helmet.
- Scribe: A content proposal for Scribe that runs from the first consultation to filming (full body or at the mic, on proper kit) and the monthly tweaks after.
- Driven: Driven is a docuseries about what women are up against in motorsport, told through candid interviews and real race footage, and produced by Current.
- IKEA Frystä: A pitch for FRYSTÄ, frozen meals from IKEA.
- NYC Students, in Data: I made three charts from New School research into how students in New York live.
- Cozy: Cozy mixes streetwear, home goods and sportswear, with a lot of nostalgia in it.
- The Mycelium Project: We wanted to make everyday objects out of something that could be left outdoors and would feed the plants around it.
- Nike Financial Analysis: A financial analysis of Nike: who owns it, how the stock has done, its bonds and ratios, and what all that says about its strategy.
- The 5th Element Miami: A night in Miami for Social Haus based on The Fifth Element, putting artists, influencers and entrepreneurs inside the film's world.
- RL Prestige by Ralph Lauren: What if Ralph Lauren had a luxury line built around polo culture, with aged Scotch at the centre? I worked out the concept and how it would look, and kept it recognisably Ralph Lauren.
- LVMH Value Chain: What would LVMH have to change to run a regenerative business? I mapped its value chain, from the supply chain to stakeholders and environmental impact, then used a systems map and a causal diagram to see how the group could balance profit against its sustainability targets.
- The Hat Dilemma: Most men's hats are a cap or a beanie.
- The Toilet Project: Why do toilets all look the same? I started from the most ordinary one, the exposed-trapway toilet, and used Raymond Loewy's MAYA rule (most advanced, yet acceptable) to judge how far it could change.
- Titanic: Who survived the Titanic, broken down by age, sex and class.
- Chilewich x Hockney: A collaboration I pitched between Chilewich and David Hockney.
- Le Cocon: A day bed you lie inside instead of on.
- LVMH and Kering Style Guide: A style guide for LVMH and Kering: colours, type and layout templates so everything they put out looks consistent.
- Zayd Turk at Jams (2024): Fifteen flyers for Zayd Turk's vinyl nights at Jams, 1414 6th Ave, all through 2024.
- Rumble in the Jungle: A boxing party with one rule: no phones.
- The Palace: Sixteen flyers for The Palace, on West Broadway and on Canal St, for Zack Bia, Jonas Blue, Yung Bae, Young Paris, Michael Simpson and others.
